test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 26 Oct 2023)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option in direct speech.

options.text: The principal said to me, “You are in-charge of the admission cell.”
The principal say me, “You are in-charge of the admission cell.”
The principal said to I, “You are in-charge of the admission cell.”
The principal said me, You are in-charge of the admission cell.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The principal said to me, “You are in-charge of the admission cell.”**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• When converting a sentence to Direct Speech, ensure the correct punctuation and structure are used.
 
• The introductory phrase should use **"said to"** when addressing someone directly.
 
• The pronoun "**me**" is correctly used after "**said to**".
 
• The **quoted speech** should be enclosed** in quotation marks.**

 
 

 **Correct Direct Speech**
 **Incorrect Submission**
 
 

 The principal said to me, “You are in-charge of the admission cell.”
 All other options
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***The principal said to me, “You are in-charge of the admission cell.”**.*
